title: Industrial Design Intern
note: Paid summer watch-design internship for ID/product design majors graduating Spring 2027–Spring 2028; portfolio required.

facts.summary: 10-week paid summer internship supporting Fossil's watch design teams at its Texas HQ.
facts.duties: Research trends, sketch, make mood boards and color/material studies, prepare presentations, work with samples, and present a capstone project to leadership.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's student in industrial/product design graduating Spring 2027–Spring 2028; sketching; Adobe CS; portfolio; SolidWorks/KeyShot preferred.
facts.apply: Apply through Fossil's careers portal (linked from the Built In listing).
